what_is_being_signed: the owner accepts W0_AUTHOR_DESIGN_COMPLETE for this candidate and its bound evidence

window.field_note: lane_policy_epoch is the lane-routing registry epoch; registry_rev_at_open is the runner registry revision the window was opened against

canonical_rule.notes: window.ops_used excluded: it does not exist until after signing

must_bind.source: Requested round, window kind, and required completion level
must_bind.why: Limit acceptance to this round and W0 author-design completion.
Bind the exact candidate path, byte length, and content digest.
Bind the exact officer evidence artifact.
Bind the gate artifact digest and explicit summary, including the remaining reporting finding; the supplied digest identifies the gate file, not a separately hashed summary.
Bind all six receipt identifiers, digests, and byte lengths without substitution or omission.
Identify OWNER as signer, EXECUTE as assembler, and VERIFY as certifier; role labels do not independently authenticate actors.

must_bind.source: INLINE DATA.window, policy_epoch, owner_fingerprint_prefix, and authoritative signing-event operation count
must_bind.why: Bind acceptance to the specified owner window, opening epoch, owner key prefix, and operation budget.

forbidden_in_body: Any self-digest, including payload_sha256 or a hash of body.
The signature itself or its enclosing signing envelope.
Claims of zero open findings, all 19 gates passing, or completion beyond W0_AUTHOR_DESIGN_COMPLETE.
Unresolved placeholders in the final signed body.
Additional fields or substituted evidence not specified here.
verifier_must_check: Reject the template until ops_used is replaced with the authoritative integer count for the signing event; verify it is within the window's four-operation budget.
Verify canonical serialization exactly, then independently compute SHA-256 over the signed body bytes and compare it with the envelope's payload_sha256.
Cryptographically verify the signature using the independently authorized full OWNER public key; its fingerprint must start with d42c654c, but prefix matching alone is insufficient authorization.
Check the authoritative window is WIN-df9526589010, has kind owner_semantic_accept, opened at policy epoch 40, and is valid for this signing event under applicable policy.
Enforce the exact body structure and values specified here, except for the resolved ops_used integer.
Recompute each referenced artifact's digest from its raw bytes, check every supplied byte length, and require exactly the six listed receipt identifiers with no duplicates.
Verify the digest-bound gate artifact actually reports total=19, pass=18, blocking_fail=0, and open_reporting_findings=1; do not treat its file digest as a standalone summary digest.
Independently authenticate EXECUTE's assembly provenance and VERIFY's certification against these same artifacts; the owner's signature and role labels do not replace either check.
Reject positive ORIGINAL_ACK assertions, self-digests, broader completion claims, and replay outside the authorized round and window.
what_the_signature_will_not_mean: It will not establish ORIGINAL_ACK or any original-author acknowledgment.
It will not mean every gate passed or the reporting finding was closed or waived.
It will not establish execution, deployment, operational readiness, or completion beyond W0_AUTHOR_DESIGN_COMPLETE.
It will not replace EXECUTE assembly provenance, VERIFY certification, or independent evidence verification.
It will not authenticate an owner solely through a fingerprint prefix or authorize later artifact substitutions.
